A '''star''' was located in the [[Jaguada system/Legends|Jaguada system]]<ref name="DL" /> in the [[Sith Worlds/Legends|Sith Worlds]] region. It constituted a part of the [[Esstran sector/Legends|Esstran sector]]<ref name="OuterRim" /> in the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="OuterRim" /> Along with the rest of its [[Star system/Legends|system]], the [[Star/Legends|star]] was situated along the [[Kamat Aegit]] and [[Kamat Krote]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]]<ref name="TEA" /> and was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by the [[planet]] [[Jaguada/Legends|Jaguada]] and its sole [[Jaguada's moon|moon]].<ref name="DL" />

By [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]'' to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> the star was dying. During the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|hunt]] for [[Roan Shryne]] and his companions that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], Jaguada's star was depicted as part of a large [[Holomap/Legends|holomap]] of the Jaguada system that was displayed before [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] in the [[Jedi Temple central security station/Legends|beacon room]] of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="DL" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jaguada's star was introduced in the [[2005]] novel ''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]'', written by [[James Luceno]]. Apart from being mentioned in the novel, the planet also appeared in a holographic representation of the entire Jaguada system.<ref name="DL" /> The Jaguada system, and therefore the star, was placed in grid square R-5 by the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.<ref name="TEA" />
